ledger.observation_closes_rule: No observation is supplied; a lone runtime branch would be path-specific and would not supply edition/layout qualification.

compatibility.required: Keep invalid/incomplete encodings, absent properties and contradictory editions distinct. Do not silently pad, reinterpret packed text zero, adopt R88 polarity across editions, or discard the missing-path continuation. Preserve residual execution and its state only through an already-qualified boundary; no new executable substitution is authorized by these records.

remaining_material_obligations: E5 selected-source qualification and polarity conflict
